metric_formulas.hierarchical_bootstrap: Stage 1: resample seeds with replacement (size n_seeds). Stage 2: within each seed draw, resample edits with replacement (size N). Pool across seed-draws and edit-resamples; recompute statistic. 95% percentile CI over N_BOOT=1000 iters. APPLIED ONLY to operational edit-level ranks and absolute/conditional ESR.
